reason: Verifier bug: diagnostic uses a fixed delay after sequential observations, not a fixed-rate schedule. 600 s produced 118 batches; nominal count assertion falsely required 119. Corrected to verify all ten tabs cover start/end (10 s tolerance) with <=10 s between observations; all recorded checks must pass. Sampler also skips setInterval ticks while a probe is in flight. Removed the exact nominal sample-count assumption; existing monotonic duration coverage and every <=3000 ms interval remain mandatory.
